subject: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Dear Christian,


I hope you are doing well. 


My name is Sara from Avicenna. We've received your request for a meeting. Thank you very much for your interest in our product and also for sharing this information about your project with us. We'd be happy to help you with your research.


We built Avicenna to allow researchers and clinicians to automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. I’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product.


You can seamlessly conduct your study using Avicenna, distributing questionnaires as needed and at your preferred times. We also support data collection from Fitbit devices.


Our services are compliant with GDPR, PIPEDA, HIPAA, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 regulations, and data is stored on our secure servers in Canada. However, please note that this is the default setting. We also offer on-premises deployment in which we completely deploy our service on your local machines or any cloud solution that you want. Let me know if this is something that you might be interested in and I will provide you with more details.


Regarding cost estimation, our pricing depends on three factors:

  1. The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well)
  2. The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study)
  3. The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll

I can provide you with a more accurate quote if you let me know which type of data you’re interested in collecting from Fitbit and how long each participant will be engaged in the study.


If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts.


If you like, we can arrange a brief meeting to demo our product and discuss your project. Our calendar is shared here, feel free to choose a time that is most convenient for you.


Best,

Sara

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com

Sara Farnya As you know, it's better not to share this quote in an email. Please ask her for a meeting. Also, looks like she's in France, let her know that we are also working with the government of France and say my colleague will be in France around mid-October and can meet in person if needed. 

For now, please make sure we can get her to a meeting.

subject: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Hi Christian,

Thank you for providing the details about the study.

I've discussed your project with the team, and we believe it's important to delve deeper into your requirements to ensure we provide the most accurate budget estimate. I apologize for any inconvenience, but this approach is to avoid any misunderstandings and to ensure we meet your expectations. Rest assured, our main goal is to assist you effectively with your project, and we are open to discussing pricing further if necessary.

Additionally, I wanted to mention that we are currently collaborating with the government of France on similar initiatives, which might provide some useful insights and synergies for your study. My colleague, Amin, will also be in France around mid-October, and we can arrange an in-person meeting if that would be helpful.

Could we schedule a meeting to go over the specifics of your requirements and explore how our solution can best support your study? Our calendar is shared here for your convenience. Feel free to choose a time that works best on your end.

Looking forward to speaking with you.
Best,
Sara
